cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/viewasimport

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Header struct {
	Magic   uint32
	Version uint32
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(oneline(), first(), ungrouped(), linecomment(), commented(), raw(), only())
}

-- m/oneline.lgo --
package main

import ("fmt"; "comptime")

func oneline() uint32 {
	b := []byte{7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7}
	_ = fmt.Sprint(1)
	return comptime.ViewAs[Header](b).Magic
}

-- m/first.lgo --
package main

import ("comptime"; "strconv")

func first() uint32 {
	b := []byte{7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7}
	_ = strconv.Itoa(1)
	return comptime.ViewAs[Header](b).Magic
}

-- m/ungrouped.lgo --
package main

import /* c */ "comptime"; import "os"

func ungrouped() uint32 {
	b := []byte{7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7}
	_ = len(os.Args[:0])
	return comptime.ViewAs[Header](b).Magic
}

-- m/linecomment.lgo --
package main

import // c
	"comptime"; import "strings"

func linecomment() uint32 {
	b := []byte{7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7}
	_ = strings.ToUpper("x")
	return comptime.ViewAs[Header](b).Magic
}

-- m/comment.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime" /* for ViewAs */ // trailing
	"sort"
)

func commented() uint32 {
	b := []byte{7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7}
	_ = sort.IsSorted
	return comptime.ViewAs[Header](b).Magic
}

-- m/raw.lgo --
package main

import `comptime`; import "unicode"

func raw() uint32 {
	b := []byte{7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7}
	_ = unicode.IsUpper('x')
	return comptime.ViewAs[Header](b).Magic
}

-- m/only.lgo --
package main

import "comptime"

func only() uint32 {
	b := []byte{7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7}
	return comptime.ViewAs[Header](b).Magic
}
